people.name: Tarshish

translations.web: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
translations.bsb: May the kings of Tarshish and distant shores bring tribute; may the kings of Sheba and Seba offer gifts.
translations.kjv: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
translations.asv: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall render tribute: The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
